full_prompt_en: A square close painted portrait shows a curly-haired man with round glasses looking straight toward the viewer, his face assembled from hundreds of small colored rectangles. Dark curls frame the top and sides, where blue, violet, and brown marks gather into dense shadow. His blue-green eyes sit behind thin circular rims near the upper center, sharply rendered enough to hold the gaze amid the busy surface. Thick brows arch above them, and a long nose descends toward a reddish-brown moustache and full beard. The mouth is closed and partly hidden by facial hair. A dark jacket appears at the bottom corners, with only a slim pale background visible to either side of the head. The face is not smoothly blended: short horizontal and vertical blocks of peach, coral, mustard, turquoise, magenta, olive, and cream lie side by side, changing density as they cross the cheek, forehead, and nose. In the beard, the blocks mingle with finer directional marks that suggest coarse hair. Around the eyes, smaller darker tiles give the sockets depth, while tiny pale accents enliven the irises and lens reflections. The head nearly fills the frame, leaving no room for additional objects or setting. Light seems to come softly from the upper right, brightening that side of the forehead and cheek while the opposite side retains richer violet and blue shadow. The pattern remains visible even where it creates believable facial volume. The overall composition is direct and optically lively, combining an unwavering portrait gaze with a shimmering mosaic of painted color.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形近景绘画肖像呈现一位卷发、戴圆眼镜的男子直视观者，面孔由数百个小彩色矩形构成。深卷发围住上方和两侧，蓝、紫与褐色笔块在那里聚成浓影。蓝绿双眼位于上方中央的细圆镜框后，描绘得足够清楚，在繁忙表面中仍稳住目光。浓眉在上方拱起，长鼻向下延伸至红褐胡子和浓密下巴胡须。嘴闭着，部分隐在须发中。深外套出现在下角，头的两侧只露出一条窄浅色背景。脸不是平滑晕接的：短横和短竖的桃、珊瑚、芥黄、青绿、洋红、橄榄与奶油色块并排铺开，经过面颊、额头和鼻子时密度改变。胡须里，方块与更细的定向笔痕混合，暗示粗硬毛发。眼周较小较深的色砖赋予眼窝纵深，细小浅亮点让虹膜和镜片反光活跃。头几乎填满画框，没有多余物件或环境的空间。光似从右上方柔和地到来，照亮那侧额头和面颊，另一侧保留更浓的紫蓝阴影。即使色纹构成可信的面部体积，它本身仍清晰可见。整体构图直接且视觉上活跃，把稳定不移的肖像目光与闪动的绘画色砖结合。
style_prompt_en: The image has a large-scale painted mosaic finish made from adjacent short rectangular marks of many hues. Warm peach, coral, cream, and ochre advance against violet, ultramarine, teal, and brown shadow blocks. The marks remain individually visible, yet their density and placement combine optically into continuous volume. A few precise dark curves and tiny highlights give the center stability within the shifting grid. Edges are built from accumulated tiles rather than one clean contour, while denser cool patches anchor the outer field. Soft directional light changes the balance of warm and cool blocks instead of smoothing them away. The overall effect is analytical and vibrant, with color structure carrying both texture and form.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有大尺幅绘画色砖质感，由多色相邻的短矩形笔痕构成。暖桃、珊瑚、奶油和赭色在紫、群青、青绿与褐色阴影块前凸显。笔痕逐个可见，密度与位置又在视觉中合成连续体积。少数精确深弧与细小高光使中心在变动网格中稳定。边缘由色砖累积而成，而非一条干净轮廓；较密的冷色区域稳住外部。柔和定向光改变冷暖色块的比例，却不磨平它们。整体效果细察而鲜活，色彩结构同时承担肌理与形体。
theme_en: A large close portrait of a curly-haired man with glasses built from colorful rectangular marks
theme_zh: 由彩色矩形笔痕构成的卷发眼镜男子近景肖像
name: Chuck Close
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
